prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE independent, realistic production-quality homepage design concept named "Les gestes qui comptent" for Continental Group, a real four-division business in Douala, Cameroon. This is a proposed redesign, not an implementation or evidence of real employees.
Target: a 1440px-wide scrollable website, render a single 1440 x 2160 long page. Page content edge to edge, no browser chrome, device, outer frame, option numbers, presentation labels or captions.
REFERENCE ROLES: reference 1 is an OLD homepage screenshot, only for factual brand/product context and as an ANTI-REFERENCE for the layout. REPLACE its beige split hero, posed portrait collage, rounded image masks, serif display, generic card grid. Reference 2 is the official Continental Group logo: preserve its authentic green/yellow mark and brand spelling in the header; do not invent a new logo.
Structure in order:
1. Compact white header 90px tall: official logo at left, "Le Groupe" and "Nos métiers" links, "Nous contacter" action at right. Real working-site visual proportions and legible controls.
2. A deep green cinema-like scrollytelling stage, occupying roughly 900px. Make the dominant visual a very large sharp-edged widescreen documentary close-up of Black Cameroonian hands packing a smartphone and laptop order on a physical shop workbench, tactile cardboard, hands in motion but sharp, honest side light. This is proposed photography, no posed smiling executives, no floating objects. Integrate the bold expressive condensed sans-serif heading "Équiper." into the stage at a carefully judged scale, NOT a giant generic slogan laid across all the image. Small factual supporting copy: "Continental Market" and "Téléphonie, informatique et équipement de la maison." Clear primary action "Découvrir Market". A vertical or horizontal chapter navigation with four equally legible text links "Market", "Energy", "Software", "Pressing", with only Market active. Include the concise group introduction "Commerce, énergie, logiciels et soin textile à Douala." The scene, offer, and useful action must be understandable at once. No badge rows, stats, metrics, icon tiles or rounded cards.
3. Below, show the next large narrative chapter "Alimenter." with an art-directed macro image of a Black technician's hands working on a wall-mounted power inverter, physical materials and precise tools. A restrained short text "Continental Energy" and "Des équipements pour vos besoins en énergie." with "Découvrir Energy". Compose this differently in scale from the first chapter, but in one coherent visual system. The transition between photographs should imply a match-cut between practical hand gestures, illustrating what scroll will animate. No arrows explaining implementation.
4. A quiet clear closing region that still gives direct links to Software and Pressing and a plain contact action; do not make a features inventory.
Visual direction: precision of a beautifully edited craft documentary; deep Continental forest green, neutral white, natural photo colors, a very small non-glowing yellow brand accent. Solid surfaces, no decorative gradients, no neon, no glassmorphism, no poster grain filters. Use Barlow Condensed style display typography and a crisp readable sans body, maximum two fonts, body visually equivalent to 16px at 1440px. Prioritize grouping, whitespace, image scale, alignment and hierarchy over borders and shadows. This should feel commissioned by a specific African business, not a SaaS template. Each chapter is a full scene, never a card. All visible text in correct French. No invented statistics, testimonials, brands on uniforms, dates, awards or claims. This is a single cohesive concept; do not add alternative designs or commentary to the image.
status: concept - photography generated for art direction, not documentary evidence
